findings.description: End-to-end 'a codex member completes a real ralph phase' goal over-claimed; codex lacks the primitives so the realistic outcome is the enumerated-blockers findings doc.
findings.resolution: Added 'Realistic expected outcome' framing to Overview; acceptance made an explicit OR with the findings doc required in both branches.

findings.description: /brainstorm-with-ralph uses Claude-only Agent(run_in_background)+background Bash (F2/F3), so it cannot isolate crews-codex membership from ralph primitive gaps; a brainstorm failure conflates the two.
findings.resolution: Inserted a primitive-free lifecycle-only codex member smoke (US-003, gate 4) BEFORE any ralph workflow; brainstorm attempt is now US-004 and runs only after the lifecycle smoke passes.

findings.description: The codex member spawn is an interactive wt.exe TUI; acceptance was not autonomous-verifiable and lacked a manual-vs-autonomous driving contract.
findings.resolution: gate 4 / US-003 now define an explicit autonomous-vs-interactive driving contract with a fallback: record the interactive-driving blocker and STOP (no silent hang); operator drives manually and the agent records the result.

findings.section: Scope / Files to Create/Modify / Acceptance Criteria
findings.description: .ralph/jobs/ and .ralph/brainstorms/ are TRACKED in codexu (only worktree/ gitignored), so leaving throwaway artifacts would pollute the committed diff and contradict the 'diff = findings doc only' AC.
findings.resolution: gate 7 + Files-to-Modify + AC now mandate deleting throwaway artifacts before the final commit; transcript excerpts are captured into findings.md instead.

findings.description: `codex plugin list` reports marketplace-snapshot availability, not active install/cache state; using it as install evidence is wrong.
findings.resolution: Install evidence switched to the cache version subdirs (~/.codex/plugins/cache/...) + enabled stanzas in ~/.codex/config.toml; plugin list demoted to marketplace evidence.

findings.description: Plugin-cache refresh does not affect an already-open codex session; fresh-thread restart must be a first-class gate before skill verification, not a note.
findings.resolution: Added gate 2 'Restart into a fresh codex thread/session' as an explicit precondition before skill advertisement verification (gate 3).

findings.description: 'Fresh codex thread skill advertisement captured' was underspecified — no defined capture method.
findings.resolution: gate 3 + AC now require a saved transcript excerpt of codex's skill-discovery output and recording the resolved discovery path.

findings.description: /plan-with-ralph degradation probe lacked a hard timebox value and required evidence shape (risky given the observed codex-exec recursion hang).
findings.resolution: Added a 10-minute hard timebox + saved stdout/stderr/transcript evidence + NOT-REACHED/HUNG marking to gate 6 / US-005 and the AC.

findings.description: Spike mutates global codex state (~/.codex/plugins/cache, possibly ~/.codex/config.toml hook trust) without PRE/POST snapshots or rollback notes.
findings.resolution: gate 1 now captures PRE/POST cache+config snapshots into the findings doc; a Risk-Areas bullet documents reversibility.
